build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm --filter @workspace/signalwatch-desktop exec node scripts/build-frontend.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/signalwatch-desktop exec node scripts/prepare-sidecar.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:* https:; font-src 'self' data:

bundle.longDescription: Signalwatch desktop client: public cameras, civic incidents, natural hazards and maritime positions from free, openly licensed sources.
